value.reason: The evidence is a config value, 'products.39.limitPerUser'. It looks like an app setting that caps how many units of product 39 one user can buy or claim. It holds no actual personal data: no government ID, biometric, financial account, health, child, credential, or contact information. None of the categories fits well, and 'Profile' is the closest because the setting only limits per-user account activity. The real sensitivity is very low.
